items.title: The Token HUD's Vigor (red) and Resolve (blue) boxes, above the HUD bar
items.do: Right-click Orc Warrior's token (with the system's HUD bar open at the bottom of the screen, and a window open behind it). In the red Vigor box type -5 and Enter; then +2; in the blue Resolve box type 3.
items.expect: Both boxes, and the whole Token HUD, show above the system's HUD bar and the windows, and both can be clicked. -5 deals 5 to Vigor only, +2 heals 2 of it, a plain number sets what is left of that pool (Resolve 3). The token's bars, Bloodied and Strained follow.

items.title: The status palette in groups, with names, above the HUD bar
items.do: Right-click Orc Warrior's token and open its status effects (the conditions button). Click Prone's icon, then click the word Daunted.
items.expect: The palette shows whole, above the system's HUD bar and the windows: five groups (Health, Movement, Senses, Harmful, Helpful), each icon with its name; a click on the icon or the name toggles it.

items.title: A condition's number on the token and on the HUD's pills
items.do: On Aveline's turn, Demoralize Orc Warrior (GM Force Tier 2: Vulnerable 1); give it Slowed 2 from the palette (then raise it to 3). Look at its token, then select it and look at the HUD's conditions row. Also look at a creature that already had a valued condition before the update (reload the world as GM).
items.expect: On the map, the Vulnerable and Slowed icons carry their number in a dark disc with a gold ring in the icon's lower right corner (1, then 2, then 3 when it rises). In the HUD's row, the pill shows the number in bold right after the icon, before the name. A condition applied before the update gets its numbered icon when the GM loads the world.

items.title: The Save dialog writes each Tier as the card does, readable in the dark theme
items.do: In the dark theme, have Aveline (the level 4 build) use Word of Radiance on Orc Warrior, then click Orc Warrior's Save button on the card. Then try a Save Action whose Tier pushes or knocks Prone.
items.expect: The Tiers read like the card ("[R] 3d6 Ho.", "Pushed 1", "Prone"): no "3d6[mind,holy]" and no "@Move". The [R] and the other game words are the light colors of the dark theme (as in the roll dialog), not dark blue.

items.title: A Large token can't end partly inside a wall
items.do: Drag Ogre Chieftain (2 x 2) beside a wall so that a column of its squares would end inside the rock, even only its outer part, in combat and out of it; then drag it flush against a straight wall (its side on the wall's line).
items.expect: The drag into the rock is refused: "Ogre Chieftain doesn't fit there: part of its space would be inside a wall." Flush against a wall it stands (nothing of it inside). The GM's Alt-drag still stops before the wall.

items.title: Pushing a larger creature: the cone from its nearest square (book, Chapter 3)
items.do: With Aveline beside Ogre Chieftain (2 x 2), level with its top square on its left side, use Shove (GM Force Tier 3: Pushed 3) and hover the squares beyond it; then Pull it with Drawing Light from 3 squares to its left.
items.expect: The push can go straight away or diagonally to either side, the same cone a Medium creature gets (from the Ogre's square nearest Aveline, not from its center): no side is cut off. The pull's cone points straight at Aveline from the Ogre's nearest square.
